sentences.en: The townspeople were astonishingly naive about what the smugglers were.
sentences.zh: townspeople 对走私者的真实情况竟然如此天真无知。

sentences.en: They were too naive to understand the necessity of studying.
sentences.zh: 他们太天真了，不明白学习的重要性。

sentences.en: He made heaps of money by ripping off naive suckers.
sentences.zh: 他通过欺骗那些天真的傻瓜赚了不少钱。

senses.zh: 幼稚的; 无经验的; 单纯的; 天真的; 轻信的

mnemonic: 联想记忆：native（原始的，土著的）去掉t→比土著人还要少一点阅历→天真的，幼稚的
